en.bilal-muhammad: Muhammad b. `Ali Majiluwayh (rh) narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. Yahya al-`Attar narrated to us from Muhammad b. Ahmad b. Yahya b. `Imran al-Ash`ari from al-Hasan b. Musa al-Khashab from Ghiyath b. Kulub from Ishaq b. `Ammar from al-Sadiq Ja`far b. Muhammad from his father from his forefathers (as).
The Messenger of Allah (s) said: Instruct your dying [to say and believe] “there is no god but Allah (la ilaha illallah)”, for he whose last words are “there is no god but Allah” will enter Paradise.
